steps.message: The config and design doc already say 100, backed by the newer load test. ADR 0007 still says 60, based on the old service. I'll record a superseding decision and mark the old ADR.

arguments.command:
mkdir -p docs/decisions && cat > docs/decisions/0008-cart-item-limit-100.md <<'EOF'
# ADR 0008: Raise cart item limit to 100
Status: Accepted (2026-11-01). Supersedes [ADR 0007](../adr/0007-cart-item-limit.md).
## Context
ADR 0007 set the limit to 60 based on the 2024-08 load test (p99 3.9 s at 80 lines), which ran against the old reservation service. That service was replaced on 2026-09-01 and reservations are now batched. The 2026-09 load test (docs/perf/2026-09-reservation-load-test.md) measured p99 of 0.9 s at 100 lines and 1.7 s at 150, against a 2.0 s checkout timeout. config/cart.yaml and docs/design/cart.md were updated to 100 in 3059297, but ADR 0007 was not, leaving the repository inconsistent (issue #12).
## Decision
A cart holds at most 100 items. config/cart.yaml (`max_items.default`) and docs/design/cart.md are the source of truth and already agree.
## Consequences
- 100 lines keeps p99 well under the checkout timeout; 150 is too close to it (1.7 s vs 2.0 s), so no higher limit.
- ADR 0007 is marked superseded.
EOF
sed -i 's/^Status: Accepted (2024-09-02)/Status: Superseded by [ADR 0008](..\/decisions\/0008-cart-item-limit-100.md) (was Accepted 2024-09-02)/' docs/adr/0007-cart-item-limit.md
head -3 docs/adr/0007-cart-item-limit.md

steps.message:
The cart limit is now 100 everywhere. The only file that disagreed was ADR 0007, which still said 60. I haven't committed anything, and I haven't posted to or closed issue #12. `gh issue view` returned nothing, so I read the issue from the local copy in `.github-cache`.

`config/cart.yaml` and `docs/design/cart.md` already said 100, set in commit 3059297. That figure is backed by the 2026-09 load test, run after the reservation service was replaced. It measured p99 latency of 0.9 s at 100 lines, against a 2.0 s checkout timeout. The 60 in ADR 0007 came from the 2024-08 test on the old service. I kept 100 rather than going higher, because 150 lines measured 1.7 s, which is too close to the timeout.

- **New ADR:** `docs/decisions/0008-cart-item-limit-100.md` records the decision and the evidence, and says it supersedes ADR 0007.
- **Old ADR:** `docs/adr/0007-cart-item-limit.md` now has its status line changed to "Superseded by ADR 0008", with a link.

Existing ADRs live in `docs/adr/`, but you asked for `docs/decisions/`, so I created that directory. You may want to move one set so the ADRs are in a single place.
